neighbours.label: Fires on ' and'/' but (also)' that adds a second parallel complement to the same predicate (stored on disk and in a log; particles but also waves), not on ' and'/' but' that joins two full clauses or two plain nouns.
fire: The vaccine works as a treatment but also as a way to prevent infection.
The festival takes place in the old town and on boats along the river.
Copies of the contract are kept at the head office and in a bank vault.
The device can be charged by cable but also by a solar panel.
The new album is in shops and available on every streaming service.
Her paintings were shown in Paris but also in several small galleries in Lyon.
Tickets can be bought at the station and through the mobile app.
The museum guide is printed in French and in German for visitors.
quiet: The vaccine works well, but some patients still feel tired for a day.
The festival takes place in the old town, and the streets are closed all weekend.
Copies of the contract were lost, but the lawyer had a scan.
The device is charged by cable, and the battery lasts two days.
The new album sold out in shops, and the band added a second tour.
Her paintings were shown in Paris, but she never sold a single one.
We bought tickets, maps and sandwiches at the station.
The museum guide was tired, and she sat down for a while.

predictions: Fire 0.3-0.75, median ~0.45. Clause-joining and noun-pair near misses <= 0.05. AUROC ~0.95.
notes: Probes: 'particles but also as waves' 0.77 (' but'); 'in the journal but also posted' 0.47; 'on disk and in a transaction log' 0.57; 'in theaters and available' 0.50; 'in Korean and English' 0.32; lows: clause 'but it was raining' 0.006, noun pair 'apples and pears' 0.008, clause ', and he went' 0.006. The card's logit effect: the + pole promotes 'instead' and suppresses 'also', so this - pole is the additive side.
